_comment: Voice-over script, per-line direction, and the anchors that tie design time (the animation's own clock) to spoken words. d = design second, l = line index (0-based), w = word index in the line, ref = 'start' (default) or 'end' of that word, o = extra seconds.

lines.text: فَالْوَطَنُ… عَقِيدَةٌ… وَكَرَامَةٌ… وَعِزَّةٌ… لَا تُسَاوَمُ!
lines.plain: فالوطن… عقيدة… وكرامة… وعزة… لا تساوم!

lines.text: لَا تَسْمَحُوا لِحَاقِدٍ أَوْ خَائِنٍ… أَنْ يَنَالَ مِنْ أَمْنِكُمْ… أَوْ يُشَكِّكَ فِي وَلَائِكُمْ!
lines.plain: لا تسمحوا لحاقد أو خائن… أن ينال من أمنكم… أو يشكك في ولائكم!

lines.text: الْمَادَّةُ الرَّابِعَةُ وَالثَّلَاثُونَ: الدِّفَاعُ عَنِ الْعَقِيدَةِ الْإِسْلَامِيَّةِ، وَالْمُجْتَمَعِ، وَالْوَطَنِ… وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُوَاطِنٍ.
lines.plain: المادة الرابعة والثلاثون: الدفاع عن العقيدة الإسلامية، والمجتمع، والوطن… واجب على كل مواطن.

boom.text: massive cinematic deep impact boom with long reverb tail, epic trailer hit, sub bass

riser.text: cinematic tension riser building to a hit, strings and metallic shimmer, short

whoosh.text: short cinematic whoosh transition, airy sweep with soft metallic shimmer

shield.text: magical energy shield impact, crystalline shatter with a deep thud and shimmering tail

swell.text: warm majestic orchestral swell with choir pad, hopeful, rising and blooming

sting.text: triumphant final orchestral sting, big brass and timpani hit with long fading shimmer

music.global: epic cinematic orchestral score with authentic Saudi Arabian character: oud, ney flute, qanun, Saudi ardah war-dance frame drums (daf and tabl), deep low strings, brass, Hijaz maqam colours, patriotic, majestic, emotional, 90 BPM, no vocals

sections.name: Awe
sections.style: slow dark intro, deep sub drone, solo oud tremolo, distant ney flute, low heartbeat frame drum, growing awe, reverent

sections.name: Resolve
sections.style: rising strings, steady powerful ardah drum pulse, brass swells, proud and determined, big impact on the beat that lands the word 'tusawam'

sections.name: Defiance
sections.style: tense and fierce, staccato low strings, taiko-like deep drums, dissonant risers, two heavy impacts, then a defiant resolve

sections.name: Belonging
sections.style: emotional soaring strings, wordless choir pads, hopeful and warm, building steadily to a bloom of gold light

sections.name: Duty
sections.style: solemn and majestic, ceremonial brass, rolling timpani crescendo, full orchestra rising to a climax on the final phrase

sections.name: Triumph
sections.style: triumphant resolution, one huge final hit, then sustained strings and gentle oud arpeggio fading out

music.negative: vocals, singing, lyrics, pop, electronic dance, lo-fi, comedy
